sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The sampling parameters are the ones recommended for the base model (its generation_config.json); each GGUF also carries them as general.sampling.* metadata, so llama.cpp applies them by default. QAD Q4_0 GGUF The Q4_0 build in this repository is the Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD) checkpoint, LFM2.5-24B-A2B-QAD-Q4_0.gguf. It was trained to recover the accuracy lost to Q4_0 quantization ...

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: an open-weight 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agents. Beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw.

sources.title: LFM2-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 24B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 2B active parameters — our largest model for laptops and single-GPU applications ← Back to Text Models LFM2-24B-A2B is Liquid AI's largest Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 24B total parameters with only 2B active parameters per forward pass.
